import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 5007;
    static final long INF = (long)1e9;
    static final long mod = (long)1e9 + 7;

    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        long cap, cost, flow;

        Edge(int from, int to, long cap, long cost) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static long[] d = new long[maxn];
    static long[] phi = new long[maxn];
    static List<Integer>[] g = new List[maxn];
    static int[] par = new int[maxn];

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d_val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int[] cnts = new int[n];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int ai = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            cnts[ai]++;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            add_edge(5000, i, cnts[i], 0);
        }

        for (int it = 0; it < m; it++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 99; i++) {
                long cost = d_val;
                for (int j = 0; j < 50; j++) {
                    add_edge(u + i * 50, v + (i + 1) * 50, 1, cost);
                    add_edge(v + i * 50, u + (i + 1) * 50, 1, cost);
                    cost += 2 * d_val;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 99; i++) {
            add_edge(0 + i * 50, 5001, INF, c * i);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 99; j++) {
                add_edge(i + j * 50, i + (j + 1) * 50, INF, 0);
            }
        }

        long[] result = mincost_maxflow(5000, 5001);
        System.out.println(result[0]);
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        g[u].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, cost));
        g[v].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, -cost));
    }

    static void ford_bellman(int s, int n) {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            phi[i] = INF;
        }
        phi[s] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < edges.size(); j++) {
                Edge e = edges.get(j);
                if (e.cap == e.flow) continue;
                int from = e.from;
                int to = e.to;
                long len = e.cost;
                if (phi[from] == INF) continue;
                if (phi[from] + len < phi[to]) {
                    phi[to] = phi[from] + len;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void dijkstra(int s) {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            d[i] = INF;
        }
        d[s] = 0;
        TreeSet<int[]> q = new TreeSet<>((a, b) -> {
            if (a[0] != b[0]) return Integer.compare(a[0], b[0]);
            return Integer.compare(a[1], b[1]);
        });
        q.add(new int[]{0, s});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] entry = q.pollFirst();
            int v = entry[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < g[v].size(); i++) {
                int eid = g[v].get(i);
                Edge e = edges.get(eid);
                if (e.cap == e.flow) continue;
                int to = e.to;
                long len = e.cost + phi[v] - phi[to];
                if (d[v] + len < d[to]) {
                    if (d[to] != INF) {
                        q.remove(new int[]{(int)d[to], to});
                    }
                    d[to] = d[v] + len;
                    par[to] = eid;
                    q.add(new int[]{(int)d[to], to});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long[] mincost_maxflow(int s, int t) {
        ford_bellman(s, 50);
        dijkstra(s);
        long flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (true) {
            if (d[t] == INF) break;
            long pushed = INF;
            long sum = 0;
            for (int tmp = t; tmp != s; ) {
                int eid = par[tmp];
                pushed = Math.min(pushed, edges.get(eid).cap - edges.get(eid).flow);
                sum += edges.get(eid).cost;
                tmp = edges.get(eid).from;
            }
            flow += pushed;
            cost += pushed * sum;
            for (int tmp = t; tmp != s; ) {
                int eid = par[tmp];
                edges.get(eid).flow += pushed;
                edges.get(eid ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                tmp = edges.get(eid).from;
            }
            dijkstra(s);
            for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
                phi[i] = d[i];
            }
        }
        return new long[]{cost, flow};
    }
}
